MSF-4.title: Non-UTF-8 bytes outside the specifier are corrupted in edited files

MSF-5.title: Moving a tracked relative symlink applies and leaves it dangling

MSF-6.title: ESM specifier written with a raw '#' (or '%') in the path: tsc OK, Node fails

SEM-5b.title: A non-moved file that loads a moved file by path string or non-literal import()/require() breaks
